description: This file defines the BigPipe class responsible for streaming HTML responses in chunks to improve page load performance in Drupal. It manages placeholders, embedded responses, and AJAX commands to deliver dynamic content efficiently.

classes.name: BigPipe
classes.description: Service class for streaming HTML responses in chunks using Drupal's BigPipe technique, managing placeholders, embedded responses, and AJAX commands for efficient dynamic content delivery.

methods.name: performPostSendTasks
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks after sending content, such as saving the session.

methods.name: sendChunk
methods.description: Outputs a chunk of content, either a string or an HtmlResponse, and flushes the output buffer.

methods.name: sendContent
methods.description: Main method to send a BigPipeResponse in chunks, managing placeholders, assets, and response parts.

methods.name: sendPreBody
methods.description: Sends the part of the HTML content before </body>, handling no-JS placeholders and assets.

methods.name: sendNoJsPlaceholders
methods.description: Renders and sends no-JS BigPipe placeholders as embedded HTML responses.

methods.name: sendPlaceholders
methods.description: Renders and sends BigPipe placeholders as embedded AJAX responses in sequence.

methods.name: filterEmbeddedResponse
methods.description: Filters embedded responses using the cumulative AJAX page state.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Dispatches response events to filter a response based on the request.

methods.name: sendPostBody
methods.description: Sends the remaining HTML content after </body>.

methods.name: renderPlaceholder
methods.description: Renders a placeholder independently, returning its render array.

methods.name: getPlaceholderOrder
methods.description: Determines the order of placeholders in the HTML for execution.

methods.name: splitHtmlOnPlaceholders
methods.description: Splits HTML into fragments based on placeholder strings, handling large patterns efficiently.
